coverage_rule: Include only named individual dramatic characters directly named by the selected Seven Seas English revised Volume 1 synopsis. This yields Rudeus Greyrat. The earlier-life adult is not separately named in the selected English witness and is represented only as a previous-life/identity dimension for Rudeus, never as a second character node. No relationships are added because the selected English metadata names no second individual.
omissions: All other named light-novel characters, family members, teachers, classmates, rivals, deities, peoples, and factions are omitted because the selected Seven Seas Volume 1 synopsis does not name them.

The 2019 first Seven Seas printing/ebook text, Japanese MF Books Volume 1, web novel, manga, anime, games, later light-novel volumes, guidebooks, spin-offs, and all adaptations are separate witnesses.

Roles/classes, races/species, magic, items, places, reincarnation/isekai systems, and themes are terms/dimensions rather than character nodes unless the selected English witness individually names and describes an agent.

Sexualization, harassment, age-disparate interaction, abuse, and related sensitive material are not asserted as Volume 1 character claims from this metadata. The selected synopsis supports only adult prior-life memories in a reborn infant's body, family expulsion, social isolation, traffic death, and reincarnation; broader content must be evidenced in a separately inspected prose pass.
The official anime's later-season framing and game marketing are not evidence for this light-novel-volume pass.
uncertainties: The Seven Seas product page provides synopsis and edition metadata but no accessible prose chapter/page excerpt. This is therefore a narrow official-metadata pass, not a primary-prose extraction or quotation.

The publisher page identifies the initial 2019 release and announces a March 2021 re-edit, saying revised paperbacks carry a specified copyright-page statement. The selected evidence does not enumerate all textual differences; no unchanged-wording claim is made.

Rudeus is the name given after rebirth in the English synopsis. It supports continuity of memories from an unnamed prior life, not a claim that the former adult is a distinct current person, an age-equivalence conclusion, or a complete theory of identity/personhood.

KADOKAWA's later MF Books Volume 7 advertisement says it depicts years not covered on the web. It supports a web/light-novel distinction at franchise level only; it is not character or plot evidence for this Volume 1 pass.

Family expulsion, prolonged social isolation/shut-in framing, traffic death, adult-memory/infant-body reincarnation, and swords-and-sorcery adventure are content cautions. Allegations or descriptions of sexualization, harassment, minors, abuse, or later conduct require page-level source evidence and are intentionally not supplied here.
evidence_basis: Seven Seas first-party revised-English Volume 1 product metadata, with KADOKAWA and official anime pages used only to preserve original-edition, web/light-novel, and adaptation boundaries.
